Verso: "Return this" [three lines of illegible writing pertaining to framing] (George Of, graphite). Mounting board: "Stieglitz Exhibition / Anderson Galleries / 1923 / Helen Freeman / 41A" (unidentified hand, graphite). Backing: 1. "{5star} / For OK to sign" (Alfred Stieglitz, black ink) 2. "Series I – No. 3 – 1918 / by Georgia O'Keeffe" (Alfred Stieglitz, black crayon) 3. "Stieglitz #2" (George Of, graphite) 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] Estate of the artist [1887–1986] (Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA); [2] 1993, Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Abiquiu, New Mexico, USA); [3] December 26, 1997, purchased by Jane Bradley Pettit Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) and gift to Milwaukee Art Museum (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press; Washington, DC: National Gallery of Art; Abiquiu, NM: The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1999), p. 137, cat. 254. 
[3] Agreement in MAM object file 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Completed after June move to New York. The identity of "Helen Freeman," the name on the mounting board, is unknown; possibly she was a potential buyer for the picture. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
